items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: There was a famous guy called Nicodemus was an organ grinder here.

ctx.x: Was it big as an upright? It's high like that. It was on a stand. A stand on a big square like that. And it had a hand. A stand on a stand. And that's where he'd grind them. Not as big as a piano. No. Oh no, he used to push it. It had a handle on it like this. And it was high. Three feet high. Yeah, it was a man who would push it, you know. Did he play more than one tune? Oh yeah, we used to pay him. We'd hire him for so many hours. I don't know what we paid him, but we'd hire him for so many hours. And he could…
There was a famous guy called Nicodemus was an organ grinder here. I have a little write-up on him somewhere.
You don't see them no more.
